title: Reject atomic JSON batches that exceed their own recovery bounds
description: P2 correctness: atomic_write_json_batch() publishes transactions without preflighting _MAX_JOURNAL_ENTRIES, _MAX_JOURNAL_BYTES, or _MAX_RECOVERY_ARTIFACT_BYTES. A batch with more than 1024 items (or an oversized existing target/encoded journal) can create and publish a journal that _validated_journal() or _read_journal() refuses to recover; an oversized backup likewise cannot be read by rollback. The exception path then reports incomplete durable recovery and leaves a journal that blocks every future generator run. Validate all recovery limits before preparing/publishing artifacts and add boundary/crash-injection tests proving every journal the writer can create is readable by recovery.
